headline: AI is more likely than humans to form biases when hiring
plain_language_summary: The next time you apply for a job, AI may screen your résumé before any human sees it. But there's good reason to question whether AI will judge you fairly. Researchers already know that LLMs pick up human biases from their training data. New research suggests that LLMs can also develop their own biases from…
primary_subject: AI hiring and resume screening workflow
physical_environment: human resources review room with resumes and interview notes
